whoItsFor: Developers, ops folks, and individual users who want to monitor trending topics and public opinion without manual browsing. It suits anyone who wants keyword-filtered hot-topic digests pushed to chat or email channels, and who wants to self-host the data.
useCases: Aggregate multi-platform trending news and RSS feeds, filtered by keyword
Receive AI-filtered, translated, and summarized news briefs on WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, email, or Slack
Run AI-driven sentiment and trend analysis over collected data through MCP clients
